kept_items.text:
Introducing Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence

 2.8 Trillion Parameters, 1 Million Context, Native Multimodal
 Kimi Delta Attention enables up to 6.3x faster decoding in million-token contexts
 Attention Residuals deliver ~25% higher training efficiency at <2% additional
kept_items.selection_reason: Highest-engagement launch of the day; Moonshot ships 2.8T-param open-weight frontier model with major benchmark claims.

kept_items.text:
Today, we’re introducing [schema]:  a harness reaching 99% RHAE with Opus 4.8 + Fable 5 and 95.35% with GPT-5.6 Sol on ARC-AGI-3 Public set.

[schema] makes an LLM think like a physicist.

kept_items.author: h100envy
kept_items.text:
Google engineer explained how to fine-tune a tiny LLM from 46% to 90% accuracy on your phone in 21 minutes - better than $1500 on-device AI bootcamps.

pick Gemma 270M -> generate synthetic task data -> fine-tune with LoRA -> quantize to int4 -> deploy to Pixel and hit 2000
kept_items.selection_reason: Useful concrete technical recipe, strong engagement.

kept_items.author: SciTechera
kept_items.text:
Demis Hassabis says there's a 50% chance we'll reach AGI by 2030. with some obvious margins of error. 

"The point is it could happen, depending on things like recursive self-improvement."

> He defines AGI as a system that demonstrates all the cognitive abilities humans have
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete public statement from Hassabis on AGI timeline.

kept_items.author: lazyapoorv
kept_items.text:
We raised $5.5M to build an AI hardware interface that knows what you want.

The world has changed: we talk to our devices, AI writes our emails, and self-driving cars pick us up.

But how we interact with it all, touchscreens and keyboards, was designed for an age of browsing
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete funding + product for post-touchscreen AI interface.
